abilities.name: Skull Banner Charge
abilities.description: When Krennik ends his turn after moving at least 20 feet, each creature of his choice that he passed within reach of during that move must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of his next turn.

abilities.name: Wheel and Run
abilities.description: Krennik ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Mounted Agility (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Krennik takes the Dash or Disengage action.

abilities.name: Banner Pursuit (1/Day) (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already below half its hit point maximum, Krennik moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Saber attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Krennik makes two attacks: one with Saber and one with Javelin.

actions.name: Saber
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If Krennik moved at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) slashing damage and, if it is Medium or smaller, is knocked prone.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Overrun (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Krennik moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is targeted once by the following effect. Each creature whose space it enters must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone.
